text: With seeds 20-23, 3000 steps and best-of-3 controls held fixed, does an N=64 arm give a normalized accel_step margin in the same 0.66-0.73 band as N=16 and N=256, while the force margin falls monotonically from 0.24-0.28 (N=16) to 0.03-0.04 (N=256)? If so, it is force, not accel_step, that tracks sampling coarseness.
